data.reasoning: The qwen model's report is invalid due to API errors (HTTP 400) when evaluating the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO, so it carries no verdict signal. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly identified the PKGBUILD as a standard Zig build with pinned, checksummed sources and no malicious execution in the global scope or build functions.
data.disagreement_analysis: The apparent disagreement is solely due to the qwen model failing to complete its audit of the core files due to an API error, resulting in an inconclusive verdict, whereas the deepseek model successfully completed the audit and found the package safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO and PKGBUILD due to HTTP 400 API errors, resulting in an inconclusive verdict.
learnings: When a model encounters API errors on specific files but succeeded in an initial global scope check, the audit tool should retry the failed files or route them to a fallback model instead of failing the entire package audit.
Transient API errors (like HTTP 400) should be handled with automatic retries to prevent valid audits from being marked inconclusive.
